integrity: The theorem is supported by a self-contained proof and standard-Python finite cross-checks; finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem and no independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for ordinary mutual visibility on labelled K_3 square K_n, n>=2, not total mutual visibility or larger row dimension. Earlier results give the general C4-free characterization and lower scalar; these are excluded from novelty. The complete Bryant-Fu 2002 paper could not be inspected, so priority remains provisional.
title: Exact visibility and facet polynomials for three-row rook graphs
